content:
nora: thinking about a 'scoped breach' rollout for AB canaries. idea: promote by tenant-groups but keep a transparent fallback path so we can reroute a single tenant instantly without global rollback.
ken: curious — transparent fallback = forked-response path or weighted dual-routing?
lia: weighted dual-routing sounds safer. keep primary path on new variant, fallback always available on old variant, and have a fast switch flag per-tenant.
own: ops question: how do we avoid cache churn when a tenant flips between paths? cache thrash will kill latency.
nora: plan: sticky cache namespaces. new variant warms under a tenant-scoped prefix; we keep warm entries for N minutes after switchback. also use an async mirror to prefill the cache before traffic shifts.
ken: need precise signals for warm readiness. what about an observable 'prefill-complete' event that includes kv-hit-rate and synthetic-latency from a mirror probe?
lia: +1. add a short sampling of production requests to be mirrored with a low QPS to validate outputs (sanity) and cache priming. mirror should be tagged so we don't charge customers.
own: rollback policies: automatic if p95 latency > threshold OR error-rate spike OR model-quality drift on sampled prompts. but also allow forced per-tenant evict API for incidents.
nora: operator UX: a compact incident view for the tenant with time-series for p50/p95, 5xx-rate, kv-miss, and last-mirror-sample. include quick actions: promote, demote, quarantine (drop to fallback).
ken: traffic shaping: we should ramp within a tenant group (0 -> 5 -> 20 -> 100) with exponential backoff on failures. controllers should implement leader election per-cohort so only one controller promotes at a time.
lia: edge case: tenant with sticky sessions across many clients. we should support token-affinity and a short grace period where both variants serve to avoid 409s. maybe 30s dual-serving window.
own: proposal for command surface (rollout-cli):
```
rollout create --group=beta-2026 --variant=v2 --steps=5,20,100 --mode=scoped
rollout status --group=beta-2026
rollout evict --tenant=acct-12345 --reason="quality spike"
```
ken: telemetry contract: must emit per-tenant rollout_state, warmup_progress, prefills_done, mirror_sample_id, and auto_rollback_reason when triggered. downstream SLO engine can subscribe.
ora: security: ensure evict and promote APIs are RBAC-guarded and require an audit-note. tie into deploy-bot for record.
deploy-bot: rollout created 1723456780 group=beta-2026 variant=v2 mode=scoped :rocket:
lia: i'll prototype the controller FSM and the mirror priming library. owen can you draft the runbook for 'evict' + postmortem checklist?
own: on it. i'll include test cases for cache retention and dual-serving windows.
ken: let's re-evaluate after the prototype demo next Tue. thanks crew.
